firmware.note: Apps resolve from catalog.flipperzero.one pinned to the device-reported SDK API; Unleashed accepts same-major builds (loader compares API major only).

entries.name: USB HID Autofire
entries.role: Show automated HID keystroke playback on a test PC at the BadUSB station.

entries.name: Better Mouse
entries.role: Show a scripted USB mouse on a test PC so players can see HID pointer control.

entries.name: Mouse Jiggler
entries.role: Show a mouse-presence keepalive the blue team can recognize as an idle-prevention HID device.

entries.name: BadUSB (stock firmware app)
entries.role: Run the stock BadUSB app on the demo DuckyScript files shipped in this pack.
Harmless HID demo: open Windows Calculator on your own test machine.
Harmless HID demo: open Notepad and type a lock-your-PC reminder.
Harmless HID demo: open a browser rickroll on your own test machine.

entries.name: Sub Analyzer
entries.role: Inspect a Sub-GHz capture taken from a remote you own.

entries.name: Sub-GHz RAW Edit
entries.role: Edit a raw Sub-GHz capture taken from equipment you own.

entries.name: Subhound
entries.role: Classify and label Sub-GHz BinRAW captures from the lab remote.

entries.name: ProtoView
entries.role: Visualize timing of an unknown protocol in a lab capture from gear you own.

entries.name: Sub-GHz Remote
entries.role: Organize saved remotes you own into a stock-style remote list.
Placeholder Princeton key that will not open anything; replace it on the lab SD card with a capture of your own remote.

entries.name: T5577 Raw Writer
entries.role: Write a T5577 tag the organizers provisioned for the lab.

entries.name: RFID Maker
entries.role: Build a lab RFID test card from organizer-issued test data.

entries.name: Wiegand Reader
entries.role: Read Wiegand from the lab test reader wiring.

entries.name: NFC Magic
entries.role: Audit magic and Gen1a test cards at the badge station.

entries.name: PicoPass
entries.role: Read PicoPass test cards issued for the lab.

entries.name: Stock NFC app (magic/Gen1a card detection)
entries.role: Detect magic and Gen1a cards with the stock NFC app on badges you are authorized to audit.

entries.name: WiFi Marauder
entries.role: Run the Wi-Fi station on the isolated lab network. Requires the ESP32-S2 Wi-Fi devboard.

entries.name: ESP Flasher
entries.role: Flash the ESP32-S2 Wi-Fi devboard used by the Wi-Fi station.

entries.name: FlipperHTTP
entries.role: HTTP client demo through the ESP32-S2 Wi-Fi devboard on the lab network.

entries.name: Cross Remote
entries.role: Drive a universal-remote layout learned from your own AV gear.

entries.name: FlipIRFreq
entries.role: Check the infrared carrier while learning a remote you own.

entries.name: IR Scope
entries.role: Scope infrared timing from a remote you own before you save it.
Placeholder NEC power pattern; learn your own TV or projector remote onto the lab SD card.

entries.name: Signal Generator
entries.role: Generate a known test signal on the GPIO bench.

entries.name: UART Terminal
entries.role: Open a UART console to a lab device you own.

entries.name: SPI Mem Manager
entries.role: Read SPI flash on a lab fixture the organizers wired up.

entries.name: Logic Analyzer
entries.role: Capture digital timing on the GPIO bench.

entries.name: Access Audit
entries.role: Review access-control cards the organizers issued for this exercise.

entries.name: Seader
entries.role: Open Seader against test credentials the organizers issued for this station.

entries.name: Seos Compatible
entries.role: Check Seos-compatible test cards issued for the competition.

entries.name: Radio Scanner
entries.role: Listen for unexpected radio activity during the blue-team sweep.

entries.name: eMRTD Reader
entries.role: Read your own e-passport or ID card over NFC (PACE/BAC) to show exactly what the document exposes.

entries.name: FlipWiFi
entries.role: Scan for rogue APs on the lab network through the ESP32-S2 Wi-Fi devboard (needs FlipperHTTP).

entries.name: FindMy Flipper
entries.role: plant an AirTag-class Find My beacon for the tracker-sweep demo
